dedupe_keys.name: seoulmmod citywide multimodal origin destination benchmark

description: SeoulMMOD is a public benchmark of hourly multimodal origin-destination flows within Seoul from 2023 to 2025. For each date and hour it gives estimated flow volume, average travel distance and average travel time between subdistricts (or districts) by six modes coded as metro bus, local bus, subway, walk, car and other. Yearly Parquet files of flows come with district and subdistrict metadata and boundary GeoJSON, a calendar of weekends and holidays, point-of-interest counts by category and hourly district rainfall for each year. The flows are processed from Seoul Open Data Plaza records. Coverage is the city of Seoul at district and subdistrict scale. Access: free download from Kaggle (about 19 GB, account needed); the processed release is under CC BY-NC 4.0, while the original records remain under the Korea Open Government Licence Type 1. Caveats: the non-commercial licence limits reuse, flows are estimates, and the provider behind the Kaggle account is not named on the page read. It supports multimodal demand modelling, network flow and mode shift studies, and rainfall-disruption analysis of urban mobility, and complements the Korean transit card ridership data catalogued here.
